visible_solution: From the screenshot, read the requested-object list and the sparse colored point cloud. For each requested object, select it, use the visible point-cloud view and the overhead, front, and side calibrated camera images to infer its 3D center, half-extents, and heading, then drag the visible cuboid handles to fit those seven fields. For every synchronized frame and each of the three views, compare the neutral camera marks with the same physical subject, click the matching mark, click LINK SELECTED MARK → BOX, and repeat for every target before submitting CERTIFY SURVEY. In the baseline full interface, orbit, pan, and zoom are optional visible view aids and the cuboid edits and mark selections use direct pointer input.
